evaluatorEntrypoints.package: npm run package --loglevel=error 2>&1 | grep -E 'PIN|rror' | tail -10; test "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" -eq 0 && wc -c dist/extension.js dist/webview.js

extraDisciplines: browser-context: src/ (except src/cli/) and webview/ run in a browser; no fs, path, child_process or sockets there, only vscode.workspace.fs and the vscode API
pure-modules: parser, resolver, wikilink, vault, ai/reference and security import neither vscode nor the DOM

cli-parity: link behaviour lives in the pure modules; vault.ts mirrors LinkIndex, and the note pattern, excluded folders and 2 MB cap in src/cli/vellum-graph.ts mirror linkIndex.ts; change both together

security-posture: strict CSP with nonces, no inline handlers, no unsafe-eval, no network requests or remote fonts; everything interpolated from workspace files is escaped through src/security.ts; vendored assets change only with new pinned digests (a human act)
stable-ids: never rename markdown-live.* commands or markdownLive.* settings
changelog: a user-visible change is recorded under Unreleased in CHANGELOG.md and in the README, saying what was not verified
known-state: the tsc enableFindWidget error and unenforced ESLint/Prettier on older files are recorded baselines, not findings; src/test/extension.test.ts is an upstream placeholder, not evidence
upstream-handoff: Vellum is a GPL-3.0 fork of thinh-vu's Markdown Live Editor; a fix that belongs upstream is a HANDOFF, and attribution in NOTICE.md and README.upstream.md is never edited
release-is-human: Marketplace publishing (publish.yml on a GitHub release) and version bumps are never proposed
